projects.smart-shift.title: Smart Shift Scheduler
projects.smart-shift.short: Workforce management SaaS with custom scheduling algorithm.
projects.smart-shift.long: Multi-tenant workforce SaaS using Next.js 16, TypeScript, and Supabase (PostgreSQL + RLS). 4-tier RBAC with complete org-level data isolation, token-based team invitations, and transactional emails. Drag-and-drop scheduling with optimistic updates, a shift-generation algorithm that cuts manual scheduling time ~75%, Recharts analytics, i18n, dark mode, and PWA. Lighthouse: 100/100/96.
projects.museum.title: Warsaw Museum Collections
projects.museum.short: Legacy React modernization with Docker environment fixes.
projects.museum.long: Modernized legacy React code from Class components to Hooks and fixed Docker environments. Implemented shopping cart logic. Reduced maintenance time and cut editorial turnaround by 30%.
projects.red.title: RED Software Site
projects.red.short: Agency website with dynamic routing and high-performance animations.
projects.red.long: Full refactor of agency site. Implemented dynamic routing for multi-language support and high-performance GSAP animations. Optimized initial load times by ~12% via asset optimization.
projects.socialman.title: Socialman
projects.socialman.short: Legacy jQuery to vanilla JS refactor with 40% performance boost.
projects.socialman.long: Refactored legacy jQuery into a vanilla JavaScript implementation. Consolidated ~6,000 lines of code down to <1,000, significantly improving maintainability. Achieved ~40% improvement in rendering performance through optimized DOM manipulation and modern JavaScript patterns.
projects.opera.title: Opera Ad Campaigns
projects.opera.short: Pixel-perfect promotional sites under strict deadlines.
projects.opera.long: Built pixel-perfect promotional sites under strict deadlines. Focused on responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, and performance optimization.
projects.elektrobohater.title: Elektrobohater
projects.elektrobohater.short: Social platform SPA with real-time feeds and filtering.
projects.elektrobohater.long: Architected a complex SPA from scratch using Redux Toolkit & React Query to handle real-time feeds and filtering for thousands of users. Built robust state management for complex user interactions.
experience.exp-1.description: Lead an agent-first development workflow, turning requirements into specs and directing Claude Code to implement while owning code review, testing, and delivery (shipping features ~2x faster). Building an AI assistant web client in React 19 and TypeScript with real-time SSE streaming, Zustand state, a type-safe OpenAPI client, and a Radix/shadcn + Tailwind UI. Added document generation (DOCX/PDF), file uploads, and voice I/O in an accessible, i18n (PL/EN) interface. ~80% test coverage with Vitest + Playwright; shipped via multi-stage Docker and Kubernetes on GitHub Actions CI/CD.
experience.exp-2.description: Built Smart Shift Scheduler, a self-initiated multi-tenant workforce SaaS (Next.js 16, TypeScript, Supabase/PostgreSQL + RLS) with 4-tier RBAC and complete org-level data isolation. Implemented drag-and-drop scheduling and a shift-generation algorithm that cut manual scheduling time ~75%, plus a Recharts analytics dashboard, i18n, dark mode, and PWA (Lighthouse 100/100/96). Engineered token-based team invitations, transactional emails, and a guided onboarding wizard. Delivered several smaller freelance web projects alongside the build.
experience.exp-3.description: Delivered 10+ commercial projects (Next.js, Gatsby) for clients including Opera and the Warsaw Museum, cutting initial load times ~12% via GSAP and asset optimization. Built Elektrobohater, a social-platform SPA, with Redux Toolkit and React Query for real-time feeds, filtering, and content management for thousands of users. Mentored a junior developer with hands-on code reviews, reducing ramp-up time ~40%.
